en: Elder Skychaser looks out over Westfall from atop Sentinel Hill.
That I must fight against my own kind deeply saddens me.
So the Searing Blade is expendable?
Warm, wholesome bread!
It is settled. I command the Might of Kalimdor. Be certain that your soldiers understand and accept this as fact. Bloodshed is already plentiful. Let there be none between our factions.

I'm a simple man who knows a few things about tailoring, but you need more assistance than I can provide. I have heard of a Night Elf who is quite an accomplished tailor. He resides in Stormwind, in the Magic District.
You look like the type I should watch my coin purse around. Something I can help you with?
Marketing - iCoke Redemption Greeting (S.H.E. giftbox)
Now, if I add the yellow ones...

And as your limp body dangles from the rafters, I shall take pleasure in knowing that a mad man has been put to death. After all, what proof do you have? Did you expect to come in here and point your fingers at royalty and leave unscathed?
We are dominating the Scourge - the effects of the altered plague will affect them for at least another full day!  We need to stay on top of it though, so be sure to sabotage a cauldron when you can.
Ramstein hunger for flesh!
Help me! Help me! Don't let them eat me!
Here is your bread sir.
What does allergic mean anyway? And what does it have to do with either of my kitties?
Attack me if you will, but you won't stop me from getting back to Quae.
Hail to thee $n.  Do you wish me to aid you in your journey to Warsong Gulch?

Hey there, $c. I've talked with everyone around here, and it seems like we have all of the stuff that the Alliance wants for the war. That mean orc ambassador said that the Horde is still gathering though, which means we have some time before we need to ship all of this stuff over to Silithus.
You there!  Yes you!  You look thirsty.  Get over here, I have just what you need!
Thanks for the cheese!

It is integral to the assimilation of this data that it is understood that the Creators wanted to synthesize a race that would long be an integral part of this world's development cycle after they had departed.  This race would be instrumental in fulfilling the Creators' long-term development objectives for Azeroth.  $B$BAs an ancillary note, the nomenclature "Earthen" was deemed apropos for the new race by the Creators, based on the Earthen's composition.
Ah, a seasoned veteran you once were. Kilram can make you this again. I know you are capable, you merely need to ask and I shall teach you the way of the axesmith.
Take me to Crown Guard Tower.

I bid you welcome, $c. Rare do we have visitors down to these levels of the Apothecarium... unless of course there's something someone wants... or needs.$B$B<Chemist Coely laughs.>$B$BHow can I help you today, hmm?
Click here to repair your gear
Onward, Crusaders! We must retake Corin's Crossing!

Greetings, $c.  I am Miranda Breechlock - one of but a few authorized equipment and materiel quartermasters for the Dawn.$B$BAs you fight evil under our commission - all the while earning our respect and trust - you'll earn valor tokens from Duke Zverenhoff.  Tokens serve two purposes: use them to gain increased standing within our ranks, or use them as tender in acquiring special items.$B$BAs you improve your standing with the Dawn, you'll discover that more items will be made available to you.
The Horde has taken the farm!

Life is meaningless. It is in death that we are truly tested.
The East Frostwolf Tower is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Alliance will destroy it!
Hail!  You look familiar... have we met before?$B$BWell if we have met, then... surely you were given a secret code. Tell me your code and I will give you a gift!

Leave it to the dwarves to send a mining specialist from Ironforge to tell us how to mine.  How hard is it to take a pick and chip away at some rock?  Well, since he's here, he's probably the one you should see anyhow.  His name is Gelman and he resides over in the Dwarven District.
